Reserve per storage volume. The larger of this reserve and the general minimum free space applies, plus room for queued downloads.
%1$d waiting for collection space
Each profile has its own favourites, language and version rules, emulator choices and action history. Game files, collections and storage recovery are shared.
Move to recovery
%1$s is in recovery storage.
Contents of %1$s moved to recovery. Empty folders remain.
Files are copied and verified in recovery storage before removal. This temporarily needs extra space. Restore them from Trash and recovery. Empty folders remain.
Delete permanently
This removes the selected file or folder immediately. No recovery copy is made.
Help with this failure
Open the relevant settings
Check the connection and any Wi-Fi-only rule. After a timeout or server limit, wait a moment before retrying.
Open Storage to check free space. Free up room or change the download folder, then retry.
Choose the affected download folder again in Settings and allow access. Check that the card is still connected and writable.
Refresh the game source and check whether this file is still listed. Try another listed source if necessary.
Check the credentials for this source or download service in Settings, then retry.
Check the archive in the file explorer and ensure room for extraction. A damaged archive should be downloaded again.
Keep the current game. Check the source checksum or DAT and download another copy before replacing any files.
Open Trash and recovery to inspect the interrupted move. Keep both folders accessible and restore or resume from the recorded operation.
Check the sync connection, selected folders and reported conflicts. Resolve conflicts before retrying the sync.
Check the cloud connection and free space. Keep the existing backup until a new one finishes successfully.
Run the health check, review the folder permissions and refresh the source before retrying.
